Centria, Satakunta University of Applied Sciences (SAMK), and Seinäjoki University of Applied Sciences (SeAMK) have deepened their strategic collaboration to strengthen the quality of education, the impact of RDI activities, and regional development in Western Finland. The partnership aims to intensify cooperation between the institutions through cross-institutional studies, joint educational offerings, and collaborative RDI projects.

Kokkolan Tiikerit is a volleyball club that plays in the Finnish Volleyball Champions League. They are looking for an intern to join their social media team. The practical training will take place between October and March, with working hours of 2–4 hours per week as well as match days on which the intern gets to participate in live sports events and share the atmosphere with Tiikerit followers. Matches take place on Sundays. The practical training is unpaid.

Centria has approximately 130 co-operative universities around the world where you can apply to both short exchanges and longer-term tuition exchanges.
